basis: Public WebAssembly bytecode function113 plus published20260409 scripts. Derived rules, not a direct original runtime side-by-side measurement.
input_correction: selection_manager._compute_targets and _issue_move/_issue_attack_move handle normal input. formation_manager._issue_move has no caller in the recovered script and was previously over-weighted.

rules.inside_box_targets: For count>1, ring of radius9.5 around clicked ground point; comparison includes bounding edges
rules.outside_box_targets: Offsets about actual selected centroid, scaled down only if max spread exceeds19*sqrt(count)*1.5
rules.batch_creation: Both normal move and attack move always create a batch; mean collision radius*sqrt(count)*2.5 is gather radius
rules.sibling_stop: Mover inside its own batch gather radius; nearby living same-team same-batch unit in state0 or6; distance < ownRadius+otherRadius+0.6*max(radius); then stop to idle
rules.arrival_priority: Ordinary inner17 arrival still accumulates0.5s before sibling check; sibling can settle movers farther from their exact goal
rules.H: Retains move batch membership; F slot assignment clears it
